title: AEGIS-RF: Hybrid Bayesian Wi-Fi Spatial Identification in Critical Information Infrastructure
description:
AEGIS-RF (Adversary-rEsistant Geolocation & Integrity for wi-fi Signals) is a demonstrative, fully reproducible software package for hybrid Bayesian spatial identification of IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi) sources in critical information infrastructure (CII).

It fuses an RSSI radiomap with FTM/RTT ranging, provides robust inference against adversarial manipulation (evil twin, deceptive ranging, deauthentication), performs critical-zone attribution, and emits Spatial Attribution Records for SOC/SIEM/SOAR integration.

The package contains a modular src/ library, a pytest reproducibility suite (metrics reproduce to 4 decimals at a fixed seed), and two Jupyter/Colab notebooks (modular and self-contained). All numeric results are demonstrative: they characterise a synthetic generative model, not field measurements. Applied project for Chapter 1 of the thesis.
notes: Demonstrative synthetic model for methodology illustration and reproducibility verification; not for operational use without validation on real data.
